title: Molecule Builder Ball-and-Stick 3D Editor with Time Control
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js (via CDN) that implements a fully interactive 3D molecule builder (ball-and-stick model) with time-control (undo/redo) capabilities.

## Scene Setup
- Black background, perspective camera at (0, 5, 15) looking at origin.
- Ambient light (intensity 0.4) + two directional lights: one from (10,10,10) intensity 0.8, one from (-5,8,-5) intensity 0.5.
- OrbitControls for camera rotation/zoom, but disable when dragging atoms.
- A translucent grid helper on the XZ plane (size 20, divisions 20) for spatial reference.

## Atom System
- Support 4 element types selectable via DOM buttons: H (white, radius 0.3), C (dark gray #333, radius 0.5), N (blue #3355FF, radius 0.48), O (red #FF2200, radius 0.46).
- Each atom is a SphereGeometry with MeshStandardMaterial, metalness 0.3, roughness 0.5.
- Atoms are placed by clicking a 'Place Atom' button, which spawns the selected element at a position offset from the camera's forward direction (distance 3 from origin, snapped to a 0.5-unit grid on XYZ).
- Each atom gets a unique incremental integer ID starting from 1.
- Atoms can be selected by raycasting (click on them in the 3D viewport). Selected atom gets an emissive highlight (emissive color #FFFF00, emissiveIntensity 0.4). Only one atom selected at a time.
- Selected atoms can be moved with arrow keys: ArrowLeft/ArrowRight move along X by 0.5, ArrowUp/ArrowDown move along Z by 0.5. Hold Shift + ArrowUp/ArrowDown to move along Y by 0.5.

## Bond System
- A 'Create Bond' button: when clicked, enters bond-creation mode. User clicks two atoms sequentially to create a bond between them.
- Bonds are rendered as CylinderGeometry (radius 0.08) stretched and oriented between the two atom centers. Use MeshStandardMaterial color #AAAAAA.
- Support single, double, and triple bonds. A 'Bond Order' dropdown (1, 2, 3) sets the order before creating a bond. Double bonds render as 2 parallel cylinders offset by 0.12, triple as 3 offset by 0.15.
- Each bond gets a unique incremental integer ID starting from 1.
- Bonds dynamically update their geometry when atoms are moved.
- A bond can be deleted by selecting it (click on a bond cylinder) and pressing Delete key.

## Molecular Properties (computed live)
- Compute and display: total molecular weight (H=1.008, C=12.011, N=14.007, O=15.999), total atom count, total bond count, and a simple formula string (e.g., 'C2H6O').
- Display these in a HUD panel (top-right, semi-transparent dark background, white text).

## Time Control (Undo/Redo)
- Maintain a full action history stack. Every action (place atom, move atom, create bond, delete bond) is recorded.
- 'Undo' button (also Ctrl+Z): reverts the last action. Removing a placed atom, restoring a deleted bond, reverting a move, etc.
- 'Redo' button (also Ctrl+Y): re-applies an undone action.
- The history stack has a maximum depth of 50 actions.
- Display current history position and total history length in the HUD (e.g., 'History: 3/5').

## Energy Estimation
- Compute a naive total bond energy: single C-C = 346, C=C double = 614, C≡C triple = 839, C-H = 411, C-N = 305, C-O = 358, N-H = 386, O-H = 459, N-O = 201 (all in kJ/mol). For unlisted pairs, use 300 kJ/mol default.
- Display total bond energy in the HUD.

## State Management
Expose window.__3D_STATE__ with these fields, updated every frame:
- atoms: array of {id, element, x, y, z} (positions rounded to 2 decimals)
- bonds: array of {id, atomA_id, atomB_id, order}
- selectedAtomId: number or null
- selectedBondId: number or null
- currentElement: string ('H','C','N','O')
- bondOrder: number (1,2,3)
- molecularWeight: number (rounded to 3 decimals)
- atomCount: number
- bondCount: number
- formula: string
- totalBondEnergy: number
- historyIndex: number (0-based current position)
- historyLength: number
- bondCreationMode: boolean
- cameraPosition: {x, y, z} (rounded to 2 decimals)
- undoCount: number (total undos performed in session)
- redoCount: number (total redos performed in session)

## DOM Elements (must have these IDs)
- #btn-h, #btn-c, #btn-n, #btn-o: element selector buttons
- #btn-place: Place Atom button
- #btn-bond: Create Bond button
- #bond-order: Bond Order select dropdown
- #btn-undo: Undo button
- #btn-redo: Redo button
- #hud-weight: molecular weight display
- #hud-atoms: atom count display
- #hud-bonds: bond count display
- #hud-formula: formula display
- #hud-energy: bond energy display
- #hud-history: history position display
physics_constraints: Molecular weight must equal the exact sum of constituent atomic masses (H=1.008, C=12.011, N=14.007, O=15.999) to 3 decimal places. Bond energy must be the exact sum of individual bond energies based on bond type and connected element pair. Atom positions must snap to 0.5-unit grid. Undo/redo must be perfectly reversible — undoing then redoing must restore exact state. Formula must list elements in Hill system order (C first, H second, then alphabetical). Conservation: undo of atom placement must also remove all bonds connected to that atom.
